def test_digitSum():
    # empty string
    assert digitSum("") == 0
    # no uppercase -> ignored
    assert digitSum("abc") == 0
    assert digitSum("123!@# ") == 0
    # single uppercase
    assert digitSum("Z") == 90  # ord('Z')
    assert digitSum("A") == 65  # ord('A')
    # all uppercase
    assert digitSum("ABC") == 65 + 66 + 67  # 198
    assert digitSum("HELLO") == 72 + 69 + 76 + 76 + 79  # 372
    # mixed case
    assert digitSum("aBcDe") == 66 + 68  # B + D = 134
    # uppercase mixed with digits/symbols/spaces
    assert digitSum("A1b2C3") == 65 + 67  # 132
    assert digitSum("aB cD") == 66 + 68  # 134
